evidence.context: Multifield time lapses were taken while samples were kept at 37 °C with 5% CO 2 with a stage top incubation system (Oko-Lab). For automated process detection in MATLAB, single Z plane TIRF images of cells over time were preprocessed for intensity thresholding prior to generating a binarized version ( https://github.com/tophamlab20/projections/blob/master/projections.m ). The Image Opening morphological filter was applied to identify the inside perimeter of the cell body.
